Complete [[Dasha Vestibule]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Complete the three trials and defeat the three [[djinn]] in the Dasha Vestibule.
* *BONUS* Collect three treasures of [[Ahdashim]] for [[Margrid]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Dasha Vestibule]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Mission
:''"The [[Sunspears]] need the aid of the [[Princes of Vabbi]].  They hide within their secret refuge.  Contact Margrid the Sly and navigate the Dasha Vestibule to reach them."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*This quest was first offered on May 10, 2009.
